root_cause.text: Missing kref_put() in the error path of gss_alloc_msg() after a kref_get() was added to balance the reference, leading to a kref leak when kstrdup_const() fails.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Commit 5940d1cf9f42 ... added a kref_get(&gss_auth->kref) call ... but forgot to add a corresponding kref_put() on the error path when kstrdup_const() fails." The patch adds `kref_put(&gss_auth->kref, gss_free_callback)` at the `err_put_pipe_version` label to fix the leak.
